mile.d: A long unit for measuring distance.

meter.d: A metric unit for measuring length.

kilometer.d: A metric unit for measuring long distances.

liter.d: A metric unit for measuring liquid.

kilogram.d: A metric unit for measuring mass.
kilogram.dEs: Una unidad métrica para medir masa.
